svg.text: 15 operational entities + 9 FHIR interoperability and clinical-history entities
FHIR R4 INTEROPERABILITY + CLINICAL HISTORY MODEL
Synthetic, read-only clinical source history; operational bookings and transactions remain in MySQL.
* PATIENT is repeated only to show the FK to the existing operational PATIENT.UHID entity.
* Dashed references are indexed logical IDs / projections, not declared MySQL foreign keys.
• Stores original FHIR JSON losslessly in FHIR_RESOURCE.
• Projects key resources into queryable relational tables.
• Normalized rows retain raw_resource JSON and synced_at.
• Uses FHIR Patient links only after staff verification.
• FHIR data is synthetic and read-only in this prototype.
Operational transactions and interoperable clinical history complement each other; FHIR does not replace hospital workflow tables.
